reviews.comment: I took Jordan's spikeball class, and it was an absolute blast, probably my favorite class I have ever taken. There is a very clear grading criteria for all assignments, and as long as you participate and put in some effort this class is a very fun, laid-back, and easy A. Jordan is a great person and teacher as well so that makes it even better.

Jordan is a great prof, I took rock climbing with him and it was super fun. He makes sure everyone in the class knows each other. The course also builds as it goes so it's good if you actually want to learn how to climb, I definitely noticed improvement between the beginning and end. Take climbing if you can especially with Jordan!
Coach Szura is a great guy and his spikeball class was descent. He makes attendance mandatory but attending class is not very burdensome and was not very demanding. People in

Jordan is a great professor to have especially for an 8am 121 course. He is super understanding and supportive of students and genuinely wants them to succeed. The physical testing is hard but he will help with suggestions of how to train or improve if necessary. He really wants you to know your classmates and create a community within this course.

Jordan is SO KIND! He genuinely cares about each student, will get to know everyone in the class, and fosters an encouraging environment. I had him last year and was so excited when I saw I had another semester with him. The class is not hard and you learn a lot, especially how the relational side of your career can impact people.
He is so so nice and truly cares about each of his students! Very encouraging
Just take paintball it is so fun!

Jordan is a great person to be around and always has an answer for anything you may present him with. This class has a lot of physical standards that can be difficult to meet if proper training prior to taking the class wasn't used. However, there are multiple retest days to get the physical grade you want.

Take this class! There are around two quizzes per week and sometimes additional assignments are due before class, but they are always quick and easy. There are no tests and the final is only worth 50 points. Attendance is mandatory, but you can miss a couple of days and it shouldn't affect your grade too much. Jordan is so nice and understanding.

Jordan Szura is by far my favorite professor I've had this year. He is very big on getting everyone to interact with each other, which was a great change of pace from lectures. At the beginning of the year, we all hardly knew each other, now we all are really great friends. 100% would take again and I wish I could have him for all my KINE classes.

Physical standards were a bit high, but realistic. Besides that, as long as you are physically active, the class should not be hard at all. Grades are 50% written assignments and 50% physical tests. He is super friendly, caring, and fosters a caring and supportive environment between students and TA's. Overall, a great class and a great professor.
I think Coach Szura might be one of the best profs I have ever taken at TAMU. Take Action Ball!

This is the only class that i have ever dreaded waking up and attending. If you hate running for a 1.5 mile, can't swim, or just are not physically active. don't take it. Also everything is timed so if you don't make the cut, you won't get a grade. He also takes away professional points. It's too tough and takes a lot of your time for other classes

Kines 121 is a cool class and is great to take with Jordan. He is super caring and wants the best for his students. You will be graded 50% on assignments and 50% on physical exams, so if you don't workout much before hand I suggest preparing for this class. Attendance is mandatory and you will gave to 10 workout classes as one of the major grades.
Just take the paintball class. I promise you won't regret it.

One of the nicest people you will ever meet. I had an injury where I couldn't play paintball for most of the semester and I thought I would have to drop the class, but Mr. Szura modified some of the labs and let me make them up later once I healed. He truly wants you to succeed and he is on your side. You also get reminders on due dates as well.

This is the easiest and most fun class I think A&M offers. My section was action ball which is a newer sport but its fun. Half your class time is spent outside playing a sport, and the assignments aren't hard either. 2 weekly quizzes and team assessments when you go to class on Tuesday. As long as you participate, you should be able to get an A.

I had him for my HKLN leads class, one hour course. So, there wasn't any real hard grading work, just played games, talked about future classes/programs at A&M, bonded, talked about issues in our world today, etc. He's sooo caring and fun, would def take him for another course

Luckily I lift so the weight room tests were easy for me, but the 1.5 mile run wasn't. Make sure to start getting in shape now. Jordan was so encouraging and there are so many retest days to get the scores you want. 2 written exams that are open ended but just write down everything from lecture and you'll be fine. Attendance is mandatory.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Such a funny and outgoing guy! Really knowledgeable guy and also made class enjoyable! If you need a free elective or just have some extra time on your hands I would 100% recommend taking a KINE199 class with him

Literally show up and do the handful of assignments throughout the year and you will get an A. I missed so much stuff and got a C which was honestly fair. What is good about this class is you also have the option to take it pass/fail which I did. Paintball was so much more fun than I thought it was going to be, take it you will not regret.
Jordan was an awesome instructor! He cares about his students' success, but you have to care too. As long as you're semi-fit and don't blow off the writing assignments, it is an attainable A!

Jordan's class was one of my favorites this semester. I frequently referred to this class as my fitness gram class. He would really try to get us to connect with our classmates while we were in person (it's a hybrid class) and it made waking up at 8 am not too terrible. Be aware that this is a physically demanding class. So start your cardio now!
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Szura was a great professor! He cares deeply about his students and their success in his class. I advise you to start working out now! You will be grateful. You dont have to be in the best physical shape for the fitness portion because youll make points up in the written portion, but still start working out early and youll get a better grade.

The assignments and tests are easy as long as you study. The physical tests aren't too difficult but if you want an A you'll need to improve your athleticism as soon as possible so that you can get the A on the physical tests. Jordan is a great guy and inspirational, definitely recommend him as a professor for this class.

I loved this class and Jordan as an instructor. He is the best instructor for this class and cares deeply for the success of his students. The two tests and online assignments that you have are really easy. The hardest part is the physical profile or workout portion, but if you commit to training during the semester for them, you will succeed.

This class in general is a pretty difficult course, and Jordan is a more difficult grader than some of the other profs. He had great lectures and required the class to work together which helped all of us bond. He was very helpful and caring and clear on what was being graded. I would definitely take him again.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational--Tough grader
